title: chore(console): move the objectui pin 4016370af3c9 → 12dc7b47c340, regime C for sharing rules (objectui#13050)
body:
Fixes #24644
Clause-②: no

This PR moves the console pin from `4016370af3c9` to `12dc7b47c340`: objectui `main` at `12dc7b47c340d9bd80b35406d890c2d27c8017dc`, the merge of objectstack-ai/objectui#13050 (the console half of regime C for sharing rules, objectui#12982). It is the newest objectui `main` commit that contains `12dc7b47` and was green at the move. The card's F1 re-test is posted on #15194 (os-dev-report 6277654282), and the regime C smoke run is below.

This PR is not a release act. The Version Packages PR is not touched, and no release workflow is dispatched. No objectui source changed.

**Tier:** not governed. `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/issue-24644-console-pin-12dc7b47` at `0b45222fef`: "0 of 5 path(s) hit the register ... NOT governed". Size: 5 files, +283 / -23.

## Choosing the pin

- **Green, read at the move.** REST `repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/commits/SHA/check-runs`, every page, read by this session at 2026-10-19T20:29:52Z and again at 20:31:01Z, just before the bump (`git ls-remote` tip `2493e85a3992` both times):

  | objectui `main` commit | check-runs at the move | verdict |
  |:--|:--|:--|
  | `2493e85a3992` (tip) | 67: 37 success, 3 skipped, **1 failure** (`Snapshot the board to the archive branch`), 26 in progress | not green: a failure, which no later run of that commit removes (re-read at 21:36Z: 101 completed, 97 success, 3 skipped, 1 failure) |
  | `cc4ae3e144e3` | 65: 44 success, 3 skipped, **3 cancelled** (`Repo Gates`, `Lint`, `Bundle Analysis`), 15 in progress | not green: three checks never reached a verdict |
  | **`12dc7b47c340`** | **29 completed: 27 success, 2 skipped, 0 failure** | **green: the target** |

  `12dc7b47c340` was never a push tip (the queue landed it with `cc4ae3e1` 14 s later), so all its runs are the `merge_group` ones: `CI` (Build & E2E, Type Check, Test 16 shards, coverage, dist pins), `Lint`, `Repo Gates`, `Governed Surface Guard`, `Changeset Presence`, all `success`. objectui `main` moved on to `df71568080e2` after the move; this PR does not re-choose.
- **The bump.** `OBJECTUI_ROOT=SCRATCH_CLONE bash scripts/bump-objectui.sh --no-commit 12dc7b47c340d9bd80b35406d890c2d27c8017dc`, exit 0: "objectui pin: 4016370af3c9 → 12dc7b47c340 (on origin/main)", and "4016370af3c9..12dc7b47c340 walks completely" in a full (non-shallow) scratch clone. ⛔ No shared `../objectui` checkout was read or written: every objectui read and build tree came from that scratch clone.
- **Ancestry,** in that clone (`--is-shallow-repository` false): the old pin `4016370af3c9` is an ancestor of `12dc7b47c340` (exit 0); objectui#12957's merge `749ed7607614` too (exit 0); control, the reverse (`12dc7b47c340` an ancestor of `4016370af3c9`): exit 1. Range: 32 non-merge commits.
- **objectui's own objectstack pin** moved in this range: `.objectstack-sha` = `f4755a68a797` (objectui `8aa8e3e1e`), was `2c9bf9430a11`. `f4755a68a797` is an ancestor of this branch's base `14ccb1da9` (exit 0), 29 commits behind it.

## The console build path, end to end

Run as `ci.yml`'s `console-pin` job runs it, heavy steps under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, each exit code captured before any pipe. Shared box, so wall-clock figures are shared-box readings. Deviations from the CI job: `--concurrency=2` (the container's resource rule), and `OBJECTUI_ROOT` names a full scratch clone where CI shallow-clones.

**Final run, at this PR's head `0b45222fef`** (the branch merged with `origin/main` `f89d29e382`, which brings #24629's `@objectstack/formula` and `core` changes into the packed packages). The build tree and the dist were deleted first.

| step | command | exit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| install | `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` | 0 |
| closure + build | `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/client... --concurrency=2 && bash scripts/build-console.sh` (lock VERDICT `command-exit 0`, held 733 s) | 0 |
| assert | the job's "Assert a real Console dist is in place" checks, `CACHE_HIT` empty: index.html, assets and `.objectui-sha` present, 65492 KB, objectui@12dc7b47c340 | 0 |
| stamp | `pnpm check:console-sha`: `✓ Console dist matches the objectui pin (objectui@12dc7b47c340).` | 0 |
| injection | `pnpm check:console-injection --require-stamp` (self-test 84 assertions; "Nothing assertable in this stamp; the dist was not contradicted") | 0 |
| manifest | `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`: 107 components, sha256 `b7a53e34856f…`; byte-identical to the committed pair (`git status --porcelain`: 0 lines) | 0 |
| manifest check | `OBJECTUI_ROOT=.cache/objectui-12dc7b47c340 node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: present, intact, recorded at the live pin, `@object-ui 17.7.0` | 0 |
| lockstep | `pnpm check:sdui-lockstep`: byte-identical to objectui@12dc7b47c340 over 214 grammar lines | 0 |

**The `.objectstack-sha` branch ran, in this order** (build log):
- `→ objectui@12dc7b47c340 installs @objectstack/client @objectstack/core @objectstack/formula @objectstack/lint @objectstack/sdui-parser @objectstack/spec @objectstack/types by commit — building them here...` (turbo 36/36);
- `→ Building objectui's own @objectstack/* at its .objectstack-sha f4755a68a797, the reference the spec assertion judges this bundle against...` (from the pin store);
- `→ OBJECTSTACK_ROOT is set: packing @objectstack/* from /home/user/objectstack-issue-24644, standing in for the pin f4755a68a797.`, `pack 7 package(s): 17.6s`, `✓ node_modules/.cache/objectstack now holds ... from /home/user/objectstack-issue-24644 (0b45222fef98)`;
- the frozen install: `Lockfile is up to date, resolution step is skipped`, `Done in 7.6s`;
- objectui's console build: 34/34 tasks, 0 cached, then `✓ 8959 modules transformed.`;
- `✓ Bundle canary 'import/jobs' present`; `✓ Single-zod canary: exactly one zod version literal {major:4,minor:6,patch:7}` (2261 `assets/*.js` read); `✓ Injected and vendored @objectstack/spec declare the same descriptions (vendored: @objectstack/spec of objectui's own build of objectstack f4755a68a797) — no observable skew`; `✓ Shipped the tracked sdui.manifest.json (recorded at objectui@12dc7b47c340, this pin).`; `✓ @objectstack/console dist ready (65492 KB) from objectui@12dc7b47c340`.

**All seven `@objectstack/*` packages objectui installs are this tree's,** read off the build tree after the install at `0b45222fef`:
- `node_modules/.cache/objectstack/.stamp.json`: `source: external`, `sha` = `0b45222fef98…`, `dirty: false`.
- `node_modules/.pnpm`: 7 `@objectstack` entries, all in the `@objectstack+NAME@file+.objectstack-pin+NAME…` form.
- each installed package's `dist/` against `packages/NAME/dist/`: `diff -rq` exit 0 for all seven (spec, core, types, client, formula, sdui-parser, lint). Control: the installed spec's `dist` against `packages/core/dist`: exit 1.
- the build tree's `pnpm-lock.yaml` (byte-identical to the one committed at `12dc7b47c340`, `cmp` exit 0): 0 registry-resolved `@objectstack/*` keys, 14 `file:` keys. Control for the pattern: objectui's lockfile at `0707b4ae3712` counts 14 registry-resolved keys.

**The in-build injection assertion is vacuous at this pin, so injection is measured independently.** Since #24532 the assertion judges the bundle against objectui's own build of its `.objectstack-sha` (`f4755a68a797`). Its probes are the `.describe()` literals 32 to 160 characters long with no escape (`describeCandidates`, `scripts/console-spec-probes.mjs`). The one spec describe that changed between `f4755a68a797` and this tree, the flow `runAs` text, is longer than 160 characters and carries an escape in the built dist, so the assertion finds no skew and the stamp records `skew: false` with null witnesses. Independent witnesses, `grep -lF` over the bundle's `assets/*.js` (counts in brackets: files in this tree's `packages/spec/dist` / in the `f4755a68a797` reference spec's `dist`):

| string | this PR's bundle | objectui's own (control) bundle |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `system flows keep system privileges; after` (flow `runAs`, [20 / 0]) | 1 | 0 |
| `A rule a package declares to share records; organizations author their own in Setup` (the `sharing_rule` type-registry entry from #24599, [16 / 0]) | 1 | 0 |
| `the trigger user until a human decision` ([20 / 0]) | 1 | 0 |
| stale: `Execution identity for the run: system = elevated (bypasses RLS), user = the triggering user` ([0 / 20]) | 0 | 1 |

So the bundle carries this tree's spec as of this PR's head, and only these witnesses tell it from objectui's own build. The control bundle is the one F1 built (os-dev-report 6277654282). On it the in-build assertion also exits 0; the release path's second check, `check:console-injection --require-stamp`, exits 1 (no stamp). Two earlier readings: against npm `@objectstack/spec@18.0.0-next.3` the two-sided assertion passes this bundle with 16 of 16 injected-only descriptions present and 0 of 2 published-only present, and against npm `18.0.0-next.5` it sees no skew either.

**An earlier run,** at `e730837` (the bump commit, before the manifest regeneration and the merge): `build-console.sh` VERDICT 0, held 719 s, the same branch order, `dist ready (65484 KB)`, seven `diff -rq` exit 0, control exit 1, 0 registry-resolved keys. It warned "Shipped the tracked sdui.manifest.json, but its record names objectui@4016370af3c9", as expected before the regeneration. That run produced the committed manifest pair and lockstep record.

## The second half: manifest and lockstep record

- `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`, exit 0: 107 components, sha256 `b7a53e34856f…`, re-recorded `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` at the pin (`built-tree`, `@object-ui/core` 17.7.0). Re-run at `0b45222fef`: exit 0, byte-identical.
- `sdui.manifest.json`: 107 → 107 components, none added or removed. Six change their inputs:
  - `list-view` publishes the spec keys its renderer honours on a page node (33 inputs added; `columns`, `filter`, `sort` and `options` re-described) — objectui `a244a172a`, objectui#13047;
  - `record:details`, `record:highlights` and `record:quick_actions` gain `emptyState` — objectui `c2191654a`, objectui#12932;
  - `action:button` and `action:icon` drop the `patch` input and re-describe `operation` — objectui `61ed5ada6`. No page in this tree authors `patch` on those nodes (`git grep` over `examples/`: 0), and `check:page-declaration-shape` passes.
- `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json`: `node scripts/check-sdui-lockstep.mjs` exit 1 before (`[pin-moved]`), `OBJECTUI_ROOT=.cache/objectui-12dc7b47c340 pnpm gen:sdui-lockstep` exit 0, then `pnpm check:sdui-lockstep` exit 0. Both blobs are unchanged (`0131f27cf86d`, `76c18fb95d1f`), so no parser port is owed.

## The console changeset

`.changeset/24644-console-pin-12dc7b47c340.md` was written by `scripts/bump-objectui.sh --no-commit` and renamed to this card's prefix, as PR #24476 did. Its list is the generator's, untouched.

- `@objectstack/console` **minor**: 28 releasing changesets across 32 non-merge commits, 1 annotated breaking, 0 release-nothing, 4 commits without a changeset (listed by subject in the changeset).
- The generator wrote its unanswered ADR-0087 placeholder, because the range declares a breaking entry, and said a human must answer it. It is answered `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` against this tree, with `Clause-②: no` beside it, as in PR #24476. That is the one hand-written part of the five files:
  - objectui `a928aaa61` (objectui#13015) makes `failures` a required member of `@object-ui/types`' `ImportJobUndoResult` and widens `@object-ui/i18n`'s `TranslationKeys`.
  - No package in this tree imports or depends on an `@object-ui/*` package (`git grep` for imports: 0). The route side of the shape is this tree's own: `UndoImportJobResponseSchema` already requires `failures`.

## F1 on the new pin

Posted on #15194 as os-dev-report 6277654282, method of 6263864885 / 6262553400, every value re-measured. **Verdict: F1 absent.** Tombstone byte probe 0 of 2261 assets in both builds; 0 banners on the 4 `permissionSets` editor pages and the 3 finance pages of a fresh showcase under `single`, for both builds; positive control 0 → 1 banner (2 errors) on both; of the two release refusals, the assertion passes the control bundle at this pin (vacuous, above) and `check:console-injection --require-stamp` refuses it (exit 1).

## Gates

All at this PR's head `0b45222fef`, after a workspace build there (`turbo run build --filter=!@objectstack/docs`, 76/76, lock VERDICT 0) and `rm -rf packages/runtime/.objectstack`. Each exit code captured before any pipe.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` (no paths: 5 paths vs merge base `f89d29e382`, three-dot) derived **72** commands. **All 72 exited 0.**
  - `--ran` reconciliation over `COMMAND :: exit N` lines: "72 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 72 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 72 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)", exit 0.
  - The same 72 also ran at `b1abdca6` (before the merge): 71 exit 0, and `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exit 3 because this shallow checkout lacked its pinned fixture commit; after `git fetch --depth=1` of that commit it exited 0.
- Named in that list and worth reading out: `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` 0 (the exemption notice names this changeset), `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main` 0, `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main` 0, `check-sdui-manifest.mjs` 0 and `--self-test` 0, `pnpm check:sdui-lockstep` 0, `pnpm check:console-sha` 0, `pnpm check:console-injection` 0, `pnpm check:objectui-changeset` 0, `pnpm check:nul-bytes` 0, `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` 0.
- Added: `pnpm check:objectui-bump` 0 ("20 assertions across 5 cases").

## CI

- **The Console Pin Gate does not run on this PR or in the merge queue** (`ci.yml`'s two speeds; the `console-pin` job's `if:` excludes `pull_request` and `merge_group`), and the fleet-write relay cannot dispatch `ci.yml`. So the **pre-merge full battery is NOT MEASURED**, and the local run above is the pre-merge reading.
- **The CI proof is `main`'s first full-battery run after the merge.** This PR changes `.objectui-sha`, so the console-dist cache key misses and that run builds the console fresh at `12dc7b47c340`. The dispatching seat reads it; if it is red, it is a `main`-red this card owns.
- The fast set (Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core, Build Core, Governed Surface Queue Guard and the rest) runs on this PR as usual.

## Acceptance notes

Observations, not filed:

- **The in-build spec assertion cannot tell this bundle from objectui's own at this pin** (above, and the open question in os-dev-report 6277654282). Its probe filter skips describe literals over 160 characters or with an escape, and that is all that changed between `f4755a68a797` and this tree's spec. Raised for the seat to decide; not changed here.
- **objectui, for the seat:** at 1440 px wide the declared sharing-rule list puts the Clone action off-screen. Measured with Playwright at 1440×1000: the first `catalog-clone-*` button's box starts at x = 1515 (outside the viewport), and the table's scroll container is 1323 px wide in a 1134 px box, so the Active switch is also cut at the right edge until the user scrolls the table sideways. At 1920 px the button is inside the viewport (x = 1806). Screenshots in the session scratchpad. The card bars objectui source changes here; the seat files it on objectui if it judges it a defect.
- For a principal who can open Setup but cannot read the activation ledger (the `ops` user above), the Active column shows `?` for each rule.
- `scripts/build-console.sh` defaults to the sibling `../objectui` when `OBJECTUI_ROOT` is unset; every run here named a scratch clone, as PR #24476 did.
